thread:
maria: Hey @alex @nate — PR #62431 is up for a kv-prefetch tweak and I need runtime/infra/security eyes before we merge. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/62431

maria: Short summary: increase prefetch TTL from 30s to 45s and enable orchestration.experimental.prefetch_mode = "aggressive" behind a flag. Goal is to reduce cache churn for medium-frequency keys. There is a possible corner-case where eviction order changes for extremely hot keys which could spike tail latency.

maria: Tests: unit + integration passed locally, CI started (see below). I added a small perf harness run in the PR (results included). Looking for: runtime validation of eviction semantics, infra signoff on rollout plan, and security ack (no secrets touched). Also need someone to own merge window and rollback plan.

alex: quick skim — code looks fine. can you paste the perf numbers inline? small asks: 95p latency and p99 token lat?

maria: sure — from the perf harness (100k reqs, mix of short/med sequences):
- baseline (ttl=30): p95=28ms, p99=120ms, 99.9p=260ms
- new (ttl=45 + aggressive): p95=27ms, p99=128ms, 99.9p=290ms
- cold-start tail improved for medium keys by ~18%

maria: TL;DR: small p99 regression (~6.7%) but much lower cache churn and fewer cache reloads in steady state. I documented fallback to old flag in config.

nate: thanks — can you add a short repro script (curl + header) we can run to reproduce the tail? also mention which model shapes you used (seq len).

maria: added script in PR: `scripts/kv_prefetch_repro.sh` (runs a mix, default seq_len=256). added notes about model shapes (mostly seq_len 128/256).

jess: I can take infra review. two asks before LGTM: 1) a telemetry event for the rollout flag so we can measure impact per-customer, and 2) a canary plan (percentages + duration). can you propose numbers? :eyes:

maria: proposing canary: 5% for 6h -> 25% for 12h -> 100% for 24h if no regressions. telemetry: `prefetch.flag_change`, `prefetch.evict_rate`, and `prefetch.cache_hits` with customer_id tag.

alex: runtime note — ensure kv eviction metric `eviction_order_shift` is emitted (boolean for big changes) so we can alert if >0.1 over baseline. can you wire that up?

maria: added metric emit and a quick alert rule suggestion in the PR description.

jess: ok I'm +1 for infra after CI green and the telemetry dataset exists. I can own the merge window. I prefer Friday 10:00 PT (low traffic) — I'll coordinate with release rotations.

nate: I'll do runtime review tomorrow morning and check the eviction semantics with the repro script. if I see unexpected behavior I'll post inline comments.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #62431 — checks: unit (running), integration (queued), perf (running).

maria: great, thanks everyone. tagging @security for visibility (no sensitive changes, but please shout if you need an artifact). If infra agrees I'll schedule Friday 10:00 PT and open a merge-window issue. :thumbsup:

jess: sounds good — I'll create the merge-window and add rollback steps. I'll also create the telemetry dataset ticket and add owners.

maria: done — created merge-window issue #789 (link in PR), and telemetry ticket #790. I'll be standing by during the rollout.

jess: thanks — assigning myself to merge and will ping when we start. :rocket:

alex: thanks, will keep an eye on alarms.

nate: adding a quick note: if runtime sees p99 spike > 150ms for 10m, auto-fallback should trigger to the old flag. please document that in the runbook.

maria: added auto-fallback threshold and runbook step in PR.

jess: CI passed all checks — unit/integration/perf ✅ — planning to merge Fri 10:00 PT unless any last objections.

maria: no objections from me. thanks team!
